outcome.answer: Yes. [1] shows that an LLM can propose experiments directly from text-based materials descriptions in an active-learning loop without conventional model training, and it reports that this training-free approach can reduce the number of experiments needed. [6] is also close: it uses LLM predictions to broadly explore the search space and then selectively choose real experiments, but it is framed as Bayesian optimization rather than direct experiment suggestion alone. [2] is another close match, showing LLMs can generate novel materials candidates through analogical reasoning and few-shot guidance.
